{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|It was 50 meters tall! It had fangs growing out of its back! Its back ridges were razor sharp! I only survived because of my lucky thermal detonator!"|Geeot Nuetia|<ref name="SWG:P18">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other|Loading Screen: Publish 18}}</ref>}}
'''Geeot Nuetia''' was an individual who lived at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Nuetia went on a [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] trip to [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] where he encountered a [[Bane Back spider]],<ref name="SWG:P18" /> a larger<ref name="SWG:TTE">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref> [[Mutant|mutated]] variant<ref name="SWG:P18" /> of [[gaping spider]].<ref name="SWG:TTE" /> When he returned, Geeot Nuetia told in the sensationalist [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] newspaper ''[[Coronet Gossip]]'' a story about a 50-meter tall spider that attacked him on Dathomir. Nuetia pretended that he killed it with a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]]. Later, a [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] went to Dathomir to learn more about the creature but the only pieces he found were comparable to a spider that was merely 2-3 meters tall.<ref name="SWG:P18" />

==Behind the scenes==
Geeot Nuetia was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:P18" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Geeot Nuetia was mentioned on a loading screen that was shown to players after the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 18 Notes for 15 Jun 2005|Publish 18]],"<ref name="SWG:P18" /> on [[June 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 18.0">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=archive%202005#june|text=Publish 18.0}}</ref> The loading screen was styled as a in-universe newspaper article and introduced the three new creatures ([[kahmurra blanca]], Bane Back spider and [[painted spat]]) added to the game with the Publish 18.<ref name="SWG:P18" /> Killing such creatures rewarded the players with a hunting trophy as decoration for their [[:w:c:swg:Housing|virtual homes]].<ref name="SWG:TTE" />
